summary:
Phase 1 (model-free) Customer Journey — backend + frontend testing. Backend: 12/12 new HTTP contract tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_journey_api_phase1.py, plus the 29 pre-existing unit tests in test_journey_phase1.py still pass. Frontend: full Playwright sweep across hub → dashboard → wizard budget block/unblock → public respondent consent → BE/Conjoint sticky-topbar regression, all green.

Backend contract confirmed on /api/journey/studies/demo-journey-kafae-001/analysis: results.matrix, results.map and results.priority are null; results.gates.order_test.p and results.gates.predictive.p are null with evaluable=false; every displayed proportion (terminals.share_ci95, routes.share_ci95, nodes.reach_ci95, nodes.burden_ci95, nodes.pain_nomination_ci95) has a 95% Wilson/t interval; terminal shares sum to 1.0; the payload contains NO NaN/Infinity tokens and no floats fail math.isfinite; respondent_count=140 for the seed. Filtered slices behave correctly — 4 distinct filter_signature values for baseline / date-window / segments={age_band:['20–29 ปี']} / segments+date, all 200, no 500 (the exact bug class the shared analysis_cache index used to hit is gone). Segment filtering actually narrows the sample (140 → smaller). Budget hard block: creating a 6-step retail_product study with target_responses=50 returns blocked=true from /budget-estimate; PUT target_responses=300 flips blocked to false. PDPA round-trip: POST /public/demojourney1/respond returns a 32-hex respondent_token, respondent_count goes 140→141; DELETE /public/demojourney1/withdraw/{bad} returns 404; DELETE with the real token returns 200 and respondent_count returns to 140. Screened-out band (recency_band='never') returns {screened_out:true} and never stores a response. POST respond with participation=false is rejected 400. Small-sample honesty confirmed end-to-end: a freshly-published test study with 5 respondents returns routes.shares_hidden=true, every top-route share is null, and gates.unlocked does not include 'routes'.

Frontend: /market-research/customer-journey shows both tabs (data-testid journey-tab-quant / journey-tab-qual). Quant tab renders journey-list; qual tab renders journey-qual-embed with exactly ONE unified topbar (no duplication). Owner dashboard /market-research/customer-journey/quant/demo-journey-kafae-001 renders all 8 required tables (journey-adequacy, journey-terminals with all 3 rows, journey-routes, journey-steps, journey-pain, journey-diagnostics, journey-gates, journey-methodology) with journey-r-analysed showing '140 คน' and journey-link-sends present. Rendered DOM contains no forbidden substrings ('Transition matrix', 'Markov', 'weighted map', 'p-value', 'p =', 'p<'). Wizard: creating a study with target=50 and 6 steps (retail_product template) reaches step 3 with journey-budget-blocked visible carrying Thai copy 'เกินเพดาน: ตั้งเป้าผู้ตอบ 50 คน รองรับได้ไม่เกิน 5 ขั้นตอน (ตอนนี้ 6)' and journey-publish-btn disabled — the blocker text names the cap in Thai as required. Removing the 6th state via journey-state-del-5 unblocks: journey-budget-ok appears and journey-publish-btn re-enables. Public respondent /journey/r/demojourney1: jy-screen-consent visible; jy-consent-participation, jy-consent-recontact, jy-consent-linkage are three SEPARATE checkboxes (never bundled); jy-next-btn is disabled until participation is ticked, and ticking participation ALONE enables it (recontact/linkage stay optional). Regression: sticky topbar remains pinned at rect.top=0 after window.scrollTo(0,800) on both /brand-equity and /market-research/conjoint-analysis (iteration_36 fix still holds).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/journey.py analysis endpoint correctly wraps journey_analysis_cache upsert in try/except (line ~1071) and keys the cache on (study_id, method, filter_sig) — the four filter-slice API calls in the new test suite produce four distinct filter_signature rows without ever colliding.

_analysis_common.parse_segments_param uses json.loads with a safe try/except; passing malformed segments= silently returns {}. Consider surfacing a 400 if the developer wants strict validation — current behaviour is intentional-permissive per docstring but might mask client-side bugs.

server.py journey_analysis_cache unique index study_method_filter_unique on (study_id, method, filter_sig) is the correct wider key. Verified via the four-slice test in test_filtered_slices_do_not_500_and_are_independent.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. The wizard test created and purged one temporary study (id auto-generated, cleaned via DELETE /studies/{id}/purge). PDPA test also submitted one response to demojourney1 and withdrew it, so demo-journey-kafae-001 remains at 140 respondents.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 CJM is production-ready per the spec: no matrix/map/priority; no p-values when non-evaluable; route shares hidden < 30 respondents; PDPA withdraw hard-deletes and expires the cache; screened-out never stored; budget hard block enforced with Thai copy that names the cap; separate participation/recontact/linkage consents; sticky topbar OK on BE + Conjoint. Not tested (out-of-scope per handoff): replay editor drag-free reordering UI (the JourneyPathBuilder chip-insert/terminal-change bottom sheet) — the public respondent flow was exercised only through the consent screen because the full end-to-end run needs a headed environment and each step has its own testids listed in the request; the API-side submission was verified separately. Reference the new test file for how to auth (session with Bearer token), how to craft a valid /studies POST body (subject is an object; sampling_frame is required), and how to submit a public response body shape.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no defects found in Phase 1 CJM.
